## What's new

- The TrimUI Brick Pro: one card boots both it and the Brick. The boot loader tells the Pro by its sticks, in about a third of a millisecond, so the boot is as quick as before, and gives it its own memory timings and screen.
- On the Pro, the buttons all work as on the Brick, and L3, R3 and both sticks are read. Games and menus don't use the sticks yet.
- A test build: please report how it boots and plays on a Brick Pro, and that a Brick boots as before.
- Everything in 2.6.0.



---

ChaOS 2.7.0-test1 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Get it** on a Brick with ChaOS 2.6.0 or later: MENU > About ChaOS > Update Channels > Pre-Release, then MENU > Updates. Or write `ChaOS-v2.7.0-test1-brick.img.xz` to a card with balenaEtcher or Raspberry Pi Imager (that erases it). ChaOS Installer installs public releases only.

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.2.0](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.2.0) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v2.7.0-test1-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).

**A test build**, before release: for the Pre-Release channel (MENU > About ChaOS > Update Channels). It can have bugs.
